annotation.title_clean: ISO 23374-1:2023 Intelligent transport systems — Automated valet parking systems (AVPS) — Part 1: System framework, requirements for automated driving and for communications interface
annotation.title_en: ISO 23374-1:2023 Intelligent transport systems — Automated valet parking systems (AVPS) — Part 1: System framework, requirements for automated driving and for communications interface
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO 23374-1:2023, an international standard for automated valet parking systems performing level 4 driverless vehicle operation in parking facilities. It specifies performance requirements, system architecture, communication interfaces between sub-systems, remote assistance and stop functions, and test procedures.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies performance requirements for level 4 automated valet parking operation
Defines logical system architecture and communication interfaces among vehicle, facility and user sub-systems
Requires management functions: vehicle-facility compatibility checks, remote assistance and recovery, operation stop commands
Provides test procedures to verify performance requirements
Excludes parking automation based solely on individual user operation
